email.subject1: a signal play for Jivox partners
email.body1:
Aanchal, saw Jivox keep widening the partner ecosystem across The Trade Desk, Xandr, and Amazon DSP.

More platform partners usually means more co-sell surface than the team can cover, so partner-sourced pipeline lags the integrations. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up across the partner ecosystem autonomously, so co-sell coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Jivox's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Aanchal, quick follow-up for Jivox.

Each new DSP alliance opens accounts neither side can fully work, so co-sell pipeline shows up later and thinner than the partnership deserves. Adding partner managers alone rarely closes that coverage gap.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through a co-sell pilot playbook and a pipeline model showing exactly how many partner-sourced meetings Jivox could cover this quarter without new hires.
email.body3:
Aanchal, last bit of proof for Jivox.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I also had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to top targets in one of your partner ecosystems. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them?
email.body4:
Aanchal, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority right now, no problem. Timing is everything, and I know standing up co-sell across that many DSP partners is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three co-sell AI-SDR plays for your ecosystem? I will tailor it to Jivox either way.
